title: MARC expects 2024 GDP to grow 4.0-5.0%, manufacturing the key driver | The Star
text:
MARC expects 2024 GDP to grow 4.0-5.0%, manufacturing the key driver | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysian Rating Corporation Bhd (MARC) expects Malaysia's 2024 real gross domestic product (GDP) to grow between 4.0 per cent and 5.0 per cent, with the manufacturing sector as the key driver.
The company said the manufacturing sector is projected to expand by 4.2 per cent (2023: 1.4 per cent).
